name: Daughter Saga 1
source:
A workaholic father must rebuild a bond with his freshman daughter who's now having troubles at her college. He believes she's being taunted at a sorority. But for this father, things usually end up being worse than they seem.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/sagas]Patreon[/url]]
